content.title: Fix E2E test isolation - dedicated test ports
content.description: E2E isolation is broken. reuseExistingServer true in playwright.config.ts reuses existing dev server on port 3000 WITHOUT AGENTRACK_CWD, so all test data writes to main .agentrack/. Need: (1) playwright.config.ts use port 3001 backend and 5174 frontend with reuseExistingServer false, (2) vite.config.ts read API_PORT and VITE_PORT env vars, (3) all e2e specs change localhost 3000 to 3001.

content.content:
Done. Fixed E2E test isolation by using dedicated test ports:

1. **playwright.config.ts** — Backend port changed to 3001, frontend to 5174, both with reuseExistingServer: false. Env vars PORT, API_PORT, VITE_PORT passed to child processes.

2. **frontend/vite.config.ts** — Reads API_PORT env var for proxy target (default 3000) and VITE_PORT env var for dev server port (with strictPort when set). Default behavior unchanged for regular dev.

3. **All 4 e2e specs** — All localhost:3000 references changed to localhost:3001.

This ensures E2E tests never accidentally reuse an existing dev server on port 3000 (which would lack AGENTRACK_CWD isolation and write test data to the main .agentrack/ directory). The server already reads PORT from env, so no server code changes needed.

Verified: typecheck passes, build succeeds.
